exposure: length of exposure to the maternal vaginal-fecal microbiome
cohort: 257 pairs of twins born to women who labored
finding: In twins born to women who labored, delivery order was not significantly associated with adverse pediatric outcomes, including asthma or allergies, suggesting that longer exposure to the maternal vaginal-fecal microbiome during labor may not significantly impact these outcomes.
mod_finding: Delivery order in twins born to women who labored and either delivered vaginally or via cesarean section was not associated with any significant differences in outcomes.
